svg.title: Teardrop roller-coaster loop
svg.desc: A teardrop loop runs leftward from entrance A at the lower right, up the left side past B, over the crown, down the right side past C, and out at D at the lower left. Curvature grows smoothly from zero at entry to its maximum at the crown; the radius is smallest at the top and larger near the base. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Speed, curvature and gravity together set the force from the track
Equal model times; actual teardrop geometry
Frictionless point car; entry speed 22 m/s; 0.05 m per original drawing unit. Time follows ds/v. N
remains positive; normal and weight arrows use one force-per-mass scale.
